title: 6919: correct viewBox casing in Radar & Packet
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary
This PR fixes an issue where the SVG `viewBox` attribute was incorrectly cased as `viewbox` in the Radar and Packet diagram renderers.

Resolves #6919
